BTCBACKPORTSVIJAY_04.title: New Dash Core — Monthly Maintenance, Cleanup & Upstream Backports
BTCBACKPORTSVIJAY_04.body: Independent upstream Bitcoin backporting and Core maintenance. Track bitcoin/bitcoin for safe improvements, adapt them through Dash's divergence (ChainLocks, InstantSend, quorums, governance), every PR reviewed and approved by Core maintainers before merge. A backport backlog is unpatched bugs — this funds the routine integration that keeps Dash secure and current without touching consensus.
milestones: 5-10 merged low-risk Dash PRs per month
100% CI and functional test pass rate
Monthly public delivery report with per-PR ledger

BTCBACKPORTSVIJAY_04.body: Four consecutive cycles funded, delivery reports on time every month, CI discipline to match. The risk profile is about as low as this DAO gets — the only question this cycle is scope.
Backport automation may reduce the manual scope in later cycles — the ask should address whether payments scale down with it.
If you can do this with just data contracts, then data contracts are already very powerful.
Will the monthly delivery reports be hosted here too? Having them attached to the proposal instead of buried in a forum thread would help a lot of us follow along.
